neighbours.label: word-initial consonant-cluster piece ' sl' / ' fl' / ' сл' tokenized apart from the rest of its word
fire: Over the summer my cousin got much slimmer by cycling to work.
The children loved the fluffier towels at the hotel.
Near the coast the land becomes flatter and wetter.
Эта задача оказалась гораздо сложнее, чем мы думали.
После болезни он чувствовал себя очень слабым.
Workers pumped the grey slurry out of the flooded mine.
The old dog fell into a deep slumber by the fire.
His excuse sounded flimsy to everyone in the room.
quiet: Over the summer my cousin got much stronger by cycling to work.
The children loved the softer towels at the hotel.
Near the coast the land becomes slick and wetter.
Эта задача оказалась гораздо проще, чем мы думали.
После болезни он чувствовал себя очень усталым.
Workers painted a new slogan on the wall of the mine.
The old dog lay on its flank by the fire.
His excuse sounded weak to everyone in the room.

predictions: Fire on ' sl'/' fl'/' сл' when the tokenizer splits the word (sl|immer, fl|atter, сл|ожн); near misses use whole-token sl/fl words (slick, slender, flank, slogan) or synonyms in the same frames.
notes: Card: ' sl' x9, ' сл' x6, ' fl' x4. Probe: сложнее 0.972, slimmer 0.764, fluffier 0.718, flatter 0.592, слабый 0.581, slumber 0.426; synonyms narrower 0.006, lower 0.036. Whole-token sl/fl words are untested, so half the near misses use them as the real test of 'split'.
